big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition on whether 8 U.S.C. 1225(b)(2)(A) mandatory detention reaches noncitizens arrested in the interior, against a multi-circuit split over a nationwide enforcement policy; plenary grant at the first conference, ACLU and NWIRP as respondent counsel. High stakes for a large detained population, but one of several parallel government vehicles on the same question rather than a singular landmark. Disclosure: the staged prediction.json files carry the predictors' big_case_score values, so I had seen them before writing this; the read above rests on the docket record and the public posture, not on those numbers.
